note: Ground-floor entrance hall of the weighing hall: the everyday adverbs of degree (more, too much, very, almost...). Adverbs have no gender (divider null). The green arched double door on the far left is the way out to the forecourt; the open doorway at the back right leads to the first quantities room. Zoom: the long weighing counter at the back.
